name: synwit
title: Synwit SWM
description: Development platform for Synwit (华芯微特) SWM series ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers. It is a thin, data-driven wrapper around the official Synwit Chip Support Library (CSL): every supported series is described by one record inside the framework-synwit package (mcu.json), so new chips only need new data, no new code.

synwit.title: Synwit StdPeriph Library
synwit.description: CMSIS-Core plus the Synwit Standard Peripheral Driver shipped by the vendor. Select the clock tree with board_build.synwit_clock, optionally enable the CMSIS-DSP / USB-Host libraries with board_build.synwit_features.
